appraisal_events.evidence: « Mais... non, si vous n'avez pas absolument besoin de moi. »; « Ce ne serait pas possible de remettre cela à demain ? »; « je sentais que je n'apprendrais jamais rien ».
appraisal_events.explanation: In the staged telephone exchange, the narrator tries to feign indifference and hold leverage over Albertine, but she repeatedly evades and postpones, leaving him anxious, dependent, and unable to secure her presence or the truth.

status_effects.explanation: Despite his strategizing to appear unaffected, the narrator ends the phone call without having secured Albertine's visit or reassurance, left in a weaker, more dependent emotional position.

ambiguities: The narrator's sense of losing leverage in the phone call is filtered entirely through his own jealous, retrospective account, so it may reflect his anxious self-perception more than an objectively staged power shift.

Françoise is dismissed from the room ('je la renvoyai avec une rude douceur') and is the object of the narrator's irritation, but the text frames this irritation as a side-effect of his anxious waiting rather than any positioning of Françoise herself, so she was judged too peripheral to score.
